preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of characters removed is between 0 and the length of the string s.
The number of characters removed is the maximum possible number of characters that can be removed optimally.
